Title: Verify that measurement group photos are uploaded and displayed correctly in a new order using configured MinIO credentials
Section: Order Management - Photo Upload and Display
Preconditions: User is logged in as a shop owner with valid MinIO credentials configured. At least one customer and item exist in the system.
Steps:
1. Navigate to the 'Create New Order' page. 
2. Select an existing customer from the dropdown. 
3. Select an item (e.g., 'Shirt') from the item list. 
4. In the measurement group section, click 'Upload Cloth Photo' and select a valid image file (e.g., JPG or PNG). 
5. Click 'Upload Pattern Cloth Photo' and select another valid image file. 
6. Fill in all required fields (e.g., delivery date, making charge). 
7. Click 'Create Order'. 
8. Navigate to the 'Order Details' page for the newly created order. 
9. Locate the measurement group section and verify the uploaded photos are displayed.

Test Data: Customer: 'John Doe', Item: 'Shirt', Cloth Photo: 'cloth_sample.jpg', Pattern Cloth Photo: 'pattern_sample.png', Delivery Date: 7 days from today, Making Charge: 500.00
Expected Result:
1. The order is created successfully with a confirmation message: 'Order created successfully'. 
2. The measurement group section in the order details page displays both the cloth photo and pattern cloth photo without any errors or broken image icons.

Title: Verify that existing measurement group photos are updated and displayed correctly when modified in an order
Section: Order Management - Photo Upload and Display
Preconditions: User is logged in as a shop owner with valid MinIO credentials configured. An existing order with at least one measurement group and uploaded photos exists in the system.
Steps:
1. Navigate to the 'Order List' page and select an existing order with uploaded photos. 
2. Click 'Edit Order' to open the order update page. 
3. In the measurement group section, click 'Change Cloth Photo' and upload a new image file. 
4. Click 'Change Pattern Cloth Photo' and upload another new image file. 
5. Update any other required fields if necessary (e.g., making charge). 
6. Click 'Update Order'. 
7. Navigate back to the 'Order Details' page for the updated order. 
8. Locate the measurement group section and verify the new photos are displayed.

Test Data: Order ID: '1-20240515-0001', New Cloth Photo: 'new_cloth_sample.jpg', New Pattern Cloth Photo: 'new_pattern_sample.png', Updated Making Charge: 600.00
Expected Result:
1. The order is updated successfully with a confirmation message: 'Order updated successfully'. 
2. The measurement group section in the order details page displays the new cloth photo and new pattern cloth photo without any errors or broken image icons.

Title: Verify that measurement group photos are retained and displayed correctly after updating other order details (non-photo fields)
Section: Order Management - Photo Upload and Display
Preconditions: User is logged in as a shop owner with valid MinIO credentials configured. An existing order with at least one measurement group and uploaded photos exists in the system.
Steps:
1. Navigate to the 'Order List' page and select an existing order with uploaded photos. 
2. Click 'Edit Order' to open the order update page. 
3. Update a non-photo field (e.g., change the making charge or add special instructions). 
4. Do NOT change or upload any new photos. 
5. Click 'Update Order'. 
6. Navigate back to the 'Order Details' page for the updated order. 
7. Locate the measurement group section and verify the original photos are still displayed correctly.

Test Data: Order ID: '1-20240515-0002', Updated Making Charge: 700.00, Special Instructions: 'Extra stitching required'
Expected Result:
1. The order is updated successfully with a confirmation message: 'Order updated successfully'. 
2. The measurement group section in the order details page displays the original cloth photo and pattern cloth photo without any errors or broken image icons.

Title: Authenticate with MinIO using empty access key and valid secret key
Preconditions: MinIO server is running and accessible. User has access to the application's file storage configuration.
Steps:
1. Navigate to the application's file storage configuration settings. 2. Enter an empty string as the access key. 3. Enter a valid secret key (e.g., 'minioadmin'). 4. Attempt to save the configuration. 5. Verify the system's response when trying to retrieve a file from MinIO.

Test Data: Access Key: '' (empty string), Secret Key: 'minioadmin'
Expected Result: The system fails to authenticate with MinIO and displays an error message indicating that the access key cannot be empty. No files can be retrieved or stored until valid credentials are provided.

Title: Retrieve a file using MinIO credentials with special characters and Unicode symbols in access key and secret key
Preconditions: MinIO server is running and accessible. User has access to the application's file storage configuration. A file exists in MinIO at a known path (e.g., 'test/test.jpg').
Steps:
1. Navigate to the application's file storage configuration settings. 2. Enter an access key containing special characters and Unicode symbols (e.g., '特殊@#$%admin'). 3. Enter a secret key containing special characters and Unicode symbols (e.g., '特殊@#$%admin'). 4. Save the configuration. 5. Attempt to retrieve the file 'test/test.jpg' via the application's file retrieval interface. 6. Observe the system's response.

Test Data: Access Key: '特殊@#$%admin', Secret Key: '特殊@#$%admin', File Path: 'test/test.jpg'
Expected Result: The system successfully authenticates with MinIO and retrieves the file 'test/test.jpg' with a 200 OK status code.
